rules.pattern: Presence-only validation accepts an artifact or field existing without checking the property it exists to prove.
rules.predicate: For every validator or acceptance criterion, identify the property asserted and require a non-presence check for that property.
rules.origin_finding: Audit pattern: criteria were satisfied by files or JSON keys existing while their substantive property remained unverified.

rules.pattern: Schema-valid-but-empty fields satisfy shape while omitting required substance.
rules.predicate: When a field carries proof, consumers, rationale, or evidence, require either non-empty substantive content or an explicit unknown/not-attempted declaration.
rules.origin_finding: Audit pattern: empty arrays and strings passed schema while hiding omitted work.

rules.pattern: Static template text is used where per-case reasoning is required.
rules.predicate: Decision rationale must reference the specific claim, surface, criterion, or repo artifact under review.
rules.origin_finding: Audit pattern: canned pending-question and rationale text passed until checked for decision-specific content.

rules.pattern: A proof or demonstration criterion is satisfied by a process artifact or documentation when it required product code, tests, or an executable slice.
rules.predicate: Proof-type criteria must declare an allowed payload class and emitted evidence must match that class.
rules.origin_finding: Audit pattern: proof requests were fulfilled with report documents instead of product-code proof slices.

rules.pattern: Evidence references are named but not dereferenced.
rules.predicate: Every evidence reference must resolve to a non-empty artifact, and typed JSON references must validate against their schema.
rules.origin_finding: Audit pattern: compatibility evidence refs were present but could point nowhere.
